SHIPPED: Comprehensive XCUITest UI test suite for Negotiation Trainer iOS app.

SIGNIFICANCE: All major user flows tested — app launch, onboarding (full flow + skip), all 4 tabs, technique tree, scenario list, profile sheets, rapid tab switching, practice button. 25 tests total.

KEY DETAILS:
- Test target: NegotiationTrainerUITests (added via Xcode → File → New → Target → UI Testing Bundle)
- Test file: NegotiationTrainerUITests/NegotiationTrainerUITests.swift
- Launch arg `--uitesting` resets onboarding state for clean test runs
- add_files.rb script exists in project root for adding files via xcodeproj gem
- Accessibility identifiers added to: MainTabView, HomeView, TechniqueTreeView, ScenarioListView, ProfileView, ExerciseSessionView, QuickStartPracticeButton, WeakSpotPracticeButton, TechniqueDetailPracticeButton, StartConversationButton, SettingsButton, StreakHistoryRow, DetailedStatsRow, AchievementsRow

ENABLES: CI/CD integration, regression detection on future changes
